issue_context.title: Allow users to fetch multiple resources at once in `get_resource` APIs
issue_context.body:
## What problem does this solve or what need does it fill?

Requesting multiple resources from the world in simple ways is more onerous and less discoverable than it should be.

`resource_scope` is a solid approach, but requires lots of complex manual boilerplate and rightward drift for something that we can just check if multiple resources are requested at once.

## What solution would you like?

Allow users to request tuples of resources from `World::get_resource` and related APIs.

For example,

```rust
let (mut pipelines.unwrap(), mut shaders.unwrap()) = world.get_resource_mut::<(Assets<PipelineDescriptor>,Assets<Shader>)>();
```

should result in a check that the two resources have compatible fetches, then grab both of the resources structured as a tuple of options, which can then be destructured.

## What alternative(s) have you considered?

Use `resource_scope` manually. This is boilerplate heavy, and less immediately clear.

Use `SystemState` to easily access arbitrary combinations of resources is less clear, and less efficient, as it constructs unneeded secondary state.

## Additional context

Initially discussed on [Discord](https://discord.com/channels/691052431525675048/896445633626538024/896445635279073330) with @TheRawMeatball.

review_comments: Can you add a test for when the resources are conflicting?
As I suggested, what happens if we ask for `ResMut<A>` twice?

Yeah getting the same mutable resource in the same get_many_resources_mut should panic. 

We've also been bitten by unsound lifetimes on direct world access so we should maybe add some compile fail tests to make sure you can't get and use multiple mutable references to the same resource or getting and use a immutable reference and an mutable reference to the same resource with multiple calls to the different get resource methods. I think it'd be similar to what is here https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/main/crates/bevy_ecs_compile_fail_tests/tests/ui/entity_ref_mut_lifetime_safety.rs

This needs doc strings. It should link back to `get_many_res`.

Ditto for `ManyResMut`.
